terra.problem: The line places Rehoboth in the Valley of Gerar, but Genesis 26:22 says Isaac moved on and does not say where the well was.
The line says Isaac found room to thrive, but the verse says the LORD had made room and they would be fruitful; it does not say they had already thrived.
“Old wells reopened” says Abraham dug the wells. Genesis 26:18 says they were dug in Abraham’s days, not that he personally dug them.
“Room at last” describes Rehoboth as a Valley of Gerar moment, but Genesis 26:22 does not establish that it happened in the valley.
